# Requirements Quality Checklist: CarryOS v2

**Purpose**: Unit tests for English: validate that requirements are complete, unambiguous, and consistent before implementation
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Product promise and IA

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec define what a visitor must understand within ten seconds without relying on implementation language?
- [ ] CHK002 Are the seven public-page sections listed as a closed set, including what must not be added?
- [ ] CHK003 Are hero, working proof, and full demo required to share one decision engine in testable language?
- [ ] CHK004 Is the source-link destination specified when no v2 remote exists?

## Inventory and readiness

- [ ] CHK005 Are all five inventory states defined with mutually exclusive entry conditions?
- [ ] CHK006 Is Ready forbidden for failed, stale, unknown, incomplete, and disconnected evidence?
- [ ] CHK007 Is readiness precedence fully ordered with no tie-break ambiguity?
- [ ] CHK008 Is it explicit that optional items never block Ready?
- [ ] CHK009 Is outside-bag test input defined as simulated and unable to produce Confirmed?

## Alerts and notifications

- [ ] CHK010 Is “one unresolved alert per activity-item pair” defined including missing↔uncertain updates?
- [ ] CHK011 Are acknowledge, suppress, resolve, and expire semantically distinct?
- [ ] CHK012 Is the actionable time window specified so warnings are not always-on?
- [ ] CHK013 Is browser permission requested only after an explicit action, with in-app notification mandatory?

## AI boundary

- [ ] CHK014 Is the model’s allowed question limited to required/optional/excluded suggestions?
- [ ] CHK015 Is unapproved model output forbidden from changing readiness, sensor state, and alerts?
- [ ] CHK016 Are unknown IDs, duplicates, multi-category items, and suggestion caps specified?
- [ ] CHK017 Is fallback labeled as not-AI and required when credentials are missing?
- [ ] CHK018 Are throttle and malformed-output visitor messages specified without exposing provider errors?

## Failure, a11y, and honesty

- [ ] CHK019 Are sensor failure, stale evidence, and missing timing each given an observable non-Ready outcome?
- [ ] CHK020 Are reduced-motion, keyboard, focus-trap, and text-equivalent state requirements present?
- [ ] CHK021 Is simulation disclosure required beside proof rather than only in a footer?
- [ ] CHK022 Are fake testimonials, metrics, hardware photos, and live-Maps claims explicitly out of scope?

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
